name: @deepgram-devs/dg-brand-ui
description: Every export of the kit: what it is, where it lives, its story and screenshot, and when to use it. The kit is domain-neutral; the fixtures hold example domains. `npm test` checks this file against src/index.ts.

surfaces.stage: Violet grain texture during the call, with frosted glass on it
surfaces.violet: The voice session panel and dock beside the paper record

entries.name: HeroLanding
entries.useWhen: The landing screen before a call: an optional hero photo (else the landing texture), persona toggle, kicker, title, intro, Start button, partner logos.
entries.avoidWhen: After the call starts; use StageLayout.

entries.name: StageLayout
entries.useWhen: During the call before a record opens, and for staff search results. The violet texture runs edge to edge; the session panel floats beside the stage from lg up, frosted, and the dock is frosted below lg.
entries.avoidWhen: When a record is open; use RecordLayout.

entries.name: StageCenter
entries.useWhen: The centered column on the stage for VoiceRing, CallStatus, and LiveCaption.
entries.avoidWhen: Search results, which use a wider left-aligned section.

entries.name: RecordLayout
entries.useWhen: A record is open: paper page, sticky TopBar, the panel beside it, the dock and a transcript sheet on phones.
entries.avoidWhen: Before there's a record to show.

entries.name: AsideNote
entries.useWhen: A muted note with a lock under the session panel: what the caller can and can't do.
entries.avoidWhen: Errors; use Notice.

entries.name: VoiceSessionPanel
entries.useWhen: The live transcript, function calls, prompts, and call controls. On every screen during a call (beside it on wide screens, in a sheet on phones). Frosted on the stage, violet beside the record: the layouts set it; pass surface="violet" beside a record screen of your own. thinking shows three dots.
entries.avoidWhen: Outside a call; on the landing screen.

entries.name: TurnBubble
entries.useWhen: One item of a custom transcript list, inside an <ol>.
entries.avoidWhen: Normally: VoiceSessionPanel renders these for you.

entries.name: ThinkingDots
entries.useWhen: Three dots at the end of a custom transcript list while the agent works on an answer.
entries.avoidWhen: Normally: pass thinking to VoiceSessionPanel.

entries.name: SessionSurfaceProvider
entries.useWhen: Set the session surface (glass or violet) for the panel, dock, and bubbles inside it, in a layout of your own.
entries.avoidWhen: Inside StageLayout or RecordLayout, which set it.

entries.name: useSessionSurface
entries.useWhen: Read the session surface (glass or violet) in a custom transcript piece, to style it to match.

entries.name: FunctionCallRow
entries.useWhen: A tool call in a transcript: one mono line with timing, expands to the request JSON.
entries.avoidWhen: Showing results; the agent's answer says what it found.

entries.name: callSummary
entries.useWhen: The one-line summary of a function call: short name and its main argument.

entries.name: clockTime
entries.useWhen: A turn's ISO time as h:mm:ss without AM/PM.

entries.name: PromptRail
entries.useWhen: TRY ASKING and quoted prompts, sent as if spoken: a sideways-scrolling row on violet, wrapping on the frosted panel.
entries.avoidWhen: More than about four prompts; on paper.

entries.name: CallControls
entries.useWhen: The mute button and End conversation.
entries.avoidWhen: Normally: the panel and the dock include it.

entries.name: SessionDock
entries.useWhen: Below lg: prompts and call controls fixed to the bottom. Pad the page by DOCK_CLEARANCE (the layouts do).
entries.avoidWhen: From lg up, where the panel shows; add className="lg:hidden" or pass it to a layout's dock slot.

entries.name: DockCaption
entries.useWhen: The dock's top row on a record screen: live dot, caption, opens the transcript sheet.
entries.avoidWhen: On the stage, where LiveCaption shows the words.

entries.name: DOCK_CLEARANCE
entries.useWhen: Bottom padding class (pb-56) for a page that shows the SessionDock outside the kit's layouts.
entries.avoidWhen: Inside StageLayout or RecordLayout, which pad for you.

entries.name: VoiceRing
entries.useWhen: Deepgram's glass voice ring on the stage, driven by turn state and a 0..1 level ref. Use ConnectedVoiceRing with Pipecat.
entries.avoidWhen: On paper or violet; more than one per screen.

entries.name: deepgram-voice-ring
entries.useWhen: The voice ring on a page without React: a static HTML page, Vue, Svelte. Load assets/ring-element/deepgram-voice-ring.js with a plain <script> (npx vdui-assets copies it), then <deepgram-voice-ring state="listening">; set ring.level (0..1) every frame and the state attribute (listening, thinking, speaking). Bundlers can import the ring-element entry instead. examples/static/index.html is a working page.
entries.avoidWhen: React apps: use VoiceRing or ConnectedVoiceRing. On paper or violet; more than one per screen.

entries.name: brand.css
entries.useWhen: A page with no build step (plain HTML, Vue, Svelte) that needs the brand: <link> it for every token as a CSS variable (var(--color-magenta), var(--font-mono)), the fonts, base styles, the kit's utilities (label, card, glass, stage-glow, magenta-band, photo-scrim), and bg-/text-/border- classes for every color. No reset. npx vdui-assets copies it. examples/static/index.html uses it.
entries.avoidWhen: Apps with Tailwind 4: import theme.css instead. Pages whose own .card, .label, or .glass classes would clash.

entries.name: useSimulatedLevel
entries.useWhen: A fake speech level for VoiceRing in stories and fixture mode.
entries.avoidWhen: A live call; use useVoiceLevelRef.

entries.name: CallStatus
entries.useWhen: The letter-spaced status line under the ring: LISTENING, SEARCHING…, PAUSED.

entries.name: LiveCaption
entries.useWhen: The caller's words, huge and quoted, on the stage. Shows a placeholder before anyone speaks.
entries.avoidWhen: On paper; use CaptionBar in the top bar.

entries.name: CaptionBar
entries.useWhen: The record screen's top-bar pill: status dot, status word, the caller's words. md and up.
entries.avoidWhen: On the stage.

entries.name: DataCard
entries.useWhen: A section of a record built by hand: white card, letter-spaced title, a FocusTarget the agent can point at. With a RecordView, RecordSectionCard makes these for you.
entries.avoidWhen: On the stage; use glass cards there.

entries.name: Field
entries.useWhen: A label over a value inside a <dl>.
entries.avoidWhen: Amounts in a list; use LineItems.

entries.name: LineItems
entries.useWhen: Label and amount rows with hairlines and an optional bold total: estimates, payments, coverage.
entries.avoidWhen: Prose or single facts.

entries.name: NoteList
entries.useWhen: Dated notes or history, oldest first: a case log, order events, an adjuster's notes.

entries.name: PlaceholderGrid
entries.useWhen: Dashed tiles with captions where photos or documents would be.
entries.avoidWhen: Real images.

entries.name: ProgressStepper
entries.useWhen: Where a process stands, in three to five steps: done, active, pending, stopped (Opened → Assigned → Working → Resolved).
entries.avoidWhen: More than five steps.

entries.name: HighlightBand
entries.useWhen: The magenta band at the top of a record: two GlassTiles and the four key numbers. One per record.
entries.avoidWhen: Anywhere else; twice on a screen.

entries.name: GlassTile
entries.useWhen: A frosted tile inside HighlightBand: who or what the record is about.
entries.avoidWhen: Outside HighlightBand.

entries.name: PageHeader
entries.useWhen: The record's heading: breadcrumb, title with status and lock pills, meta line.

entries.name: CardColumns
entries.useWhen: DataCards of different heights balanced into 2 (md) or 3 (2xl) columns.
entries.avoidWhen: A card that must be full width; put it after.

entries.name: SketchMap
entries.useWhen: A drawn map from road names with a magenta pin: a delivery address, a visit, an incident location, when there's no map API.
entries.avoidWhen: When real coordinates and a map matter.

entries.name: RecordBody
entries.useWhen: Draw a whole record screen (header, progress, highlight band, cards) from a RecordView: plain data for any domain, which the bot can send as JSON. The fastest way to a record screen.
entries.avoidWhen: When one part needs a custom layout; build from RecordSectionCard and the pieces instead.

entries.name: RecordSectionCard
entries.useWhen: One RecordSection as a card: fields, amounts, text, notes, place, files, tags, or custom.

entries.name: foundCardFor
entries.useWhen: FoundCard props from a RecordView: id, status, tile, progress.

entries.name: stepProgress
entries.useWhen: The active step's title, number, and total from a record's steps.

entries.name: FoundCard
entries.useWhen: Phones and tablets: the one record found, with progress and a magenta button to open it. foundCardFor(record, ...) builds its props from a RecordView.
entries.avoidWhen: Wide screens, which open the record directly.

entries.name: ResultCard
entries.useWhen: One match in a staff search, as a frosted button card, the whole card pressable; up to four, two by two from md. DemoExample.search.results holds its props.
entries.avoidWhen: A single found record; use FoundCard.

entries.name: DataGrid
entries.useWhen: Many records to compare at once: a staff queue on paper (tone paper), or a search with more matches than ResultCards hold on the stage (tone stage). Sortable headers, rows that open with onRowOpen, rows the agent points at by rowId, and stacked cards with a Sort by select on phones.
entries.avoidWhen: Two or three search results; use ResultCards. One record's facts or amounts; use a DataCard with Field or LineItems.

entries.name: deepgram-data-grid
entries.useWhen: DataGrid on a static site or a page without React (plain HTML, Hugo, Astro, Vue, Svelte). Write a plain <table> inside <deepgram-data-grid>, so the rows are in the HTML and show without JavaScript; load assets/data-grid/deepgram-data-grid.js with a <script> tag (npx vdui-assets copies it), and optionally deepgram-data-grid.css for a styled first paint. th attributes: data-key, data-primary, data-numeric, data-sortable="false", data-hide-on-phone, data-nowrap. tr: data-id (what grid.pointAt(ids) lights), data-href (rows become links). td: data-sort. Element: tone, sort="key:asc", pointed, openable; events sort-change and row-open. examples/static/data-grid.html is a working page.
entries.avoidWhen: React apps: use DataGrid. Two or three results on the stage: use ResultCards.

entries.name: FocusProvider
entries.useWhen: Around the screen and the panel, so the agent (and the chips) can point at FocusTargets.

entries.name: FocusTarget
entries.useWhen: A part of the screen the agent can point at: glows once and scrolls into view. DataCard and friends already are.

entries.name: useFocus
entries.useWhen: pointAt(ids) to light FocusTargets; highlight to read what's lit.

entries.name: CtaButton
entries.useWhen: The one magenta action on a screen: Start conversation, View details. size lg is full width with a glow; sm is the landing's compact pill.
entries.avoidWhen: A second action on the same screen; use PillButton.

entries.name: CtaLink
entries.useWhen: A CtaButton that's a link, such as Open on GitHub.

entries.name: PillButton
entries.useWhen: Secondary actions: Back to results, End conversation (size lg on violet; tone solid, size md on the frosted panel).
entries.avoidWhen: The main action.

entries.name: IconButton
entries.useWhen: Round icon-only buttons: settings, close, copy, mute. Always pass label.
entries.avoidWhen: Anything that needs words to be understood.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.useWhen: A small busy indicator in currentColor.

entries.name: StatusPill
entries.useWhen: A record's status in a filled pill with an icon for its tone (check, dashed circle, circled x), colored by meaning (Tone).
entries.avoidWhen: Actions.

entries.name: toneFor
entries.useWhen: Map status text to a Tone by keyword. Defaults to DEFAULT_TONE_RULES; put domain rules first.

entries.name: DEFAULT_TONE_RULES
entries.useWhen: Keyword rules that map most domains' statuses to tones (resolved/delivered → good, declined/cancelled → bad, closed → done).

entries.name: LiveBadge
entries.useWhen: LIVE / ENDED in the session panel header.

entries.name: LockPill
entries.useWhen: VIEW ONLY, or another read-only label, with a lock on paper and an eye on dark screens: the app reads records but can't change them.

entries.name: Chip
entries.useWhen: Small chips: the agent's focus chips (pointer, onClick), problems or flags (danger), tags (neutral).
entries.avoidWhen: Statuses; use StatusPill.

entries.name: SegmentedControl
entries.useWhen: Two to four choices: the persona toggle (radio, glass), a card's view switch (tab, light), or a choice on paper like ThemePicker (radio, paper).
entries.avoidWhen: More than four options; use Select.

entries.name: Select
entries.useWhen: A native select in the kit's pill field.
entries.avoidWhen: Options with images; use ImageSelect.

entries.name: ImageSelect
entries.useWhen: A select with an image per option, such as languages with flags. Full keyboard support.
entries.avoidWhen: Plain text options; use Select.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.useWhen: Initials in a circle: the caller (ink) or the signed-in person (violet).

entries.name: Notice
entries.useWhen: A message on a dark screen: error (alert), warning, or info (status).
entries.avoidWhen: On paper.

entries.name: Caret
entries.useWhen: A blinking caret after words that are still coming.

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.useWhen: A thin magenta progress bar on a dark screen.

entries.name: CopyField
entries.useWhen: A value with a copy button: the app's repo link.

entries.name: QrCode
entries.useWhen: A QR code as SVG, for booth screens: scan to open the repo.

entries.name: Wordmark
entries.useWhen: The app brand's mark and name: pill (over a landing photo), plain (the stage and the landing texture), stacked (top bar). Any fictional brand; see the example marks in the fixtures.
entries.avoidWhen: Deepgram's own logo; use PartnerLogos.

entries.name: Wordmark examples
entries.useWhen: Six example marks in one recipe (32×32, 3px outline, magenta and ring-blue accents): BrightwaveMark, WrecklessMark, NorthwindMark, CedarMark, KettleCrateMark, PlaceholderMark.
entries.avoidWhen: Shipping an app under an example brand; make its own.

entries.name: PartnerLogos
entries.useWhen: Deepgram | AWS | Pipecat (or a subset), with hairlines between: the bottom of the landing, the record's footer, and drawers. Needs npx vdui-assets.
entries.avoidWhen: On paper; the logos are white.

entries.name: PARTNERS
entries.useWhen: The partner logos the kit ships, by key.

entries.name: SettingsButton
entries.useWhen: The gear that opens Settings: glass on dark screens, solid on the top bar.

entries.name: TopBar
entries.useWhen: The record screen's sticky ink bar: brand, Back, CaptionBar, actions.
entries.avoidWhen: On the stage or landing.

entries.name: Drawer
entries.useWhen: A modal panel from the right: Settings / About this app. Focus trap, Escape, scroll lock.
entries.avoidWhen: Short confirmations.

entries.name: Section
entries.useWhen: A letter-spaced section title with content, inside a Drawer.

entries.name: ThemePicker
entries.useWhen: Dark / Light / System in the Settings drawer, in a Section titled strings.appearance. Needs ThemeProvider above it. Shows a note: what the pick changes, or the device's theme under System.
entries.avoidWhen: The ink or stage screens, which look the same in both themes; put it in the drawer instead.

entries.name: ThemeProvider
entries.useWhen: At the app's root, with themeScript() in the layout's <head>. Keeps data-theme on <html> in step: follows the device under System, follows other tabs, works with storage blocked. storageKey and defaultPreference must match themeScript()'s.
entries.avoidWhen: Forcing a theme on one screen; the ink, stage, and violet surfaces already look the same in both.

entries.name: useTheme
entries.useWhen: Read the pick and the resolved theme, or set the pick, in a custom control. ThemePicker uses it.
entries.avoidWhen: Styling: use the paper tokens (text-fg, bg-card, border-line) or the dark: variant, which follow data-theme without JavaScript.

entries.name: themeScript
entries.useWhen: The inline <head> script for the root layout: sets data-theme before the first paint, so a saved dark theme never flashes light. Add suppressHydrationWarning and data-theme="light" to <html>.

entries.name: THEME_PREFERENCES
entries.useWhen: The three picks in ThemePicker's order: dark, light, system.

entries.name: THEME_STORAGE_KEY
entries.useWhen: The default localStorage key for the pick (vdui.theme).

entries.name: DARK_QUERY
entries.useWhen: The media query System follows: (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

entries.name: KitStringsProvider
entries.useWhen: Translate or reword the kit's built-in strings.
entries.avoidWhen: Content strings; pass those as props.

entries.name: useKitStrings
entries.useWhen: Read the kit's strings in a component of your own.

entries.name: DEFAULT_STRINGS
entries.useWhen: The English defaults: the list of what to translate.

entries.name: cx
entries.useWhen: Join class names, skipping falsy ones.

entries.name: initials
entries.useWhen: Two-letter initials for an Avatar.

entries.name: useMediaQuery
entries.useWhen: Whether a media query matches; with WIDE, whether the panel sits beside the screen.
entries.avoidWhen: Layout that CSS breakpoints can do.

entries.name: WIDE
entries.useWhen: The media query (min-width: 1024px) where the panel moves beside the screen.

entries.name: useCopied
entries.useWhen: Copy to the clipboard and show Copied for a moment.

entries.name: useStickToBottom
entries.useWhen: Keep a growing log scrolled to its newest item unless the reader scrolled up.

entries.name: Icons
entries.useWhen: Stroke icons in currentColor, sized by className. Controls: MicIcon, MicOffIcon, WaveIcon, LockIcon, GearIcon, CloseIcon, GitHubIcon, CopyIcon, CheckIcon, CodeIcon, ChevronIcon, ArrowRightIcon. Generic subjects for GlassTiles: UserIcon, CalendarIcon, PinIcon, DocumentIcon, CardIcon, BoxIcon, SearchIcon, ClockIcon.
entries.avoidWhen: Domain icons (a car, a plane): draw those in the app's own code, as the fixtures do with CarIcon.

entries.name: usePipecatTurns
entries.useWhen: The live conversation as Turn[], the caption, the last call, and sendText for prompts.
entries.avoidWhen: Fixture mode; use the fixtures' turns.

entries.name: toTurns
entries.useWhen: Convert Pipecat ConversationMessage[] to Turn[] yourself, with chips and call timings.

entries.name: useMicToggle
entries.useWhen: micOn and setMic for CallControls.

entries.name: useTurnState
entries.useWhen: listening / thinking / speaking from Pipecat's speaking events.

entries.name: useVoiceLevelRef
entries.useWhen: The live audio level of caller and agent as a ref, for VoiceRing.

entries.name: ConnectedVoiceRing
entries.useWhen: VoiceRing driven by the live call.
entries.avoidWhen: Outside a PipecatClientProvider.

entries.name: useServerMessage
entries.useWhen: Handle the bot's server messages (RTVIServerMessageFrame): record-loaded, focus, search-results.

entries.name: fixtures
entries.useWhen: Five example domains as DemoExample objects (support = default, insurance, banking, healthcare, retail): brand, personas, copy, a RecordView, search results, conversations. EXAMPLES, DEFAULT_EXAMPLE, getExample(id), each example, the marks, languageOptions(), and turn builders agent()/caller()/tool(). Copy the closest example to start a domain.
entries.avoidWhen: Shipping an app with fixture data on screen.
